limitations: No historical training causality or generalization claim.
Sampled logit gradients are local detached-loss gradients, not network-parameter gradients.
A zero sampled coverage does not establish absence of shared-parameter learning.
Fixed-cutoff FP/crop is not full-volume FP/scan or an S7 gate verdict.
A/R remain pseudo-reference tasks without Level R human evidence.
scope: Frozen TRAIN crops; descriptive diagnostic only

weighting.component_weighted: One observation per component; draw summaries per component/draw
weighting.dependence: Components, queries, draws and crops are not independent patients
weighting.fractions: Dense: valid component voxels; coverage: valid positive-weight component voxels
weighting.query_supervision: One observation per crop/query/draw, including queries without components
weighting.query_weighted: Mean of components per crop/query; draw summaries per crop/query/draw
